answer: Comet-stamp sybil tax: each identity buys one comet stamp per epoch from the lantern ledger, priced 35 plus 7 per identity sharing its funding key. Auditors at the summit check each stamp's dye mark against the ledger; a reused serial burns the bond. First stamp 35, the kth 35+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented stamps fail: the dye binds one key. Honest agents pay 35 once and keep a full share.
